title: Duplicable Sherds
description: Let's you duplicate pottery sherds using basic materials.
body:
### Duplicable Sherds
Just like how you can duplicate the armor trims, this data pack allows you to duplicate pottery sherds using terracota, clay, and flower pots.

![the crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf903228bf58510f55814387e5f6469a14814f73.png)

This data pack works for every sherd following the same recipe.
